# NahaLabs

> NahaLabs is an intelligent systems engineering company based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It finds the operational problems that quietly cost businesses money or time, then engineers the intelligent systems, AI digital workers, automations and software that fix them. It serves enterprises and high-growth businesses across Gauteng, South Africa, Lesotho and the wider region.

Key facts:
- Legal name: NahaLabs (PTY) Ltd. Founder and systems architect: Thabiso Naha.
- Location: Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa. Contact: ai-solutions@nahalabs.co.za
- How projects run: fixed scope, no open-ended retainers, in three stages: Diagnosis (1-2 weeks), Prototype (2-3 weeks), Production (3-6 weeks). Engagements start with a 45-minute technical diagnosis.
- What it is not: NahaLabs does not sell off-the-shelf software or generic consulting. Each system is engineered around one client's workflows, data and commercial rules.

## Entity and authority pages

- [About NahaLabs](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/about): canonical company identity, legal name, Johannesburg location, founder Thabiso Naha, focus areas and evidence/claim discipline.
- [Public engineering work](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/systems): inspectable public repositories for Lead Machine, Demand Radar, Flavourly, CargoIQ, NahaLLM and JEV UltraFast Browser. These are labelled as public engineering evidence, not customer-result claims.
- [Press & research](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/press): company boilerplate, founder/contact details, research themes and interview/source requests.

## Core pages

- [NahaLabs home](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/): What NahaLabs builds, the systems it has engineered (Flavourly, CargoIQ, RailWatch, RevenueDesk), its Diagnosis-Prototype-Production method, an FAQ, and how to start an enquiry.
- [RevenueDesk](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/revenuedesk): NahaLabs' AI front desk and revenue-recovery offering for service businesses. Read the current page for scope and contact NahaLabs to discuss your workflow; no fixed pilot pricing is stated here.
- [Free Website Revenue Leak Audit](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/audit): Free, no-login tool. Enter a public website URL and receive a revenue leak score, prioritised findings on conversion, trust, mobile and technical issues, a fix-pack preview, and an ROI scenario calculator.

## Regional pages

- [Intelligent systems engineering in Johannesburg](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/locations/johannesburg): Bespoke intelligent systems, operational automation and business intelligence for Johannesburg enterprises, commercial leaders and fast-growing businesses.
- [Business intelligence and automation in Soweto](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/locations/soweto): Practical business intelligence, WhatsApp automation and revenue systems for township enterprises, retailers and restaurants in Soweto.
- [Systems engineering across Gauteng](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/locations/gauteng): Industrial-grade systems engineering, geospatial intelligence and enterprise automation across the Gauteng economic heartland.
- [Intelligent systems in Lesotho](https://www.nahalabs.co.za/locations/lesotho): Practical intelligent systems, cross-border customs intelligence and digital operations for businesses and institutions in Lesotho.
